# Vendored frontend assets

- `model-viewer.min.js`: `@google/model-viewer` 4.2.0, downloaded from https://unpkg.com/@google/model-viewer@4.2.0/dist/model-viewer.min.js. Copyright Google; Apache-2.0. License: https://github.com/google/model-viewer/blob/master/LICENSE. Upstream attribution comments are preserved.
- `../fonts/sentient.woff2`: Sentient Light, Indian Type Foundry / Fontshare. Source https://www.fontshare.com/fonts/sentient; supplied under Fontshare's free-font terms: https://www.fontshare.com/licenses/itf-ffl.
- `../fonts/hanken.ttf`: Hanken Grotesk variable font, Hanken Design Co. Source https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/hankengrotesk, SIL Open Font License 1.1.

These assets are served locally. Jewellery images and models are generated by the project's Blender builders, not by these libraries. No compressed GLB decoder is required by the worker's current exports.
